FIND: In `_prune_for_coherence()`, constraint density is computed using static policy constraint count, not actual directive block count, causing pruning to increase density and fail to meet coherence budget.
FALSIFIER:
```python
from bench.cdsfl_registry.composer import _prune_for_coherence, _count_constraints
from bench.cdsfl_registry.directives import DirectivePacket

packets = [
    DirectivePacket("main", " ".join(["soft"] * 200), is_universal=False, category="soft")
]
policy = {
    "soft_constraints": list(range(18)),
    "hard_constraints": list(range(2)),
}
budget = 0.01

total_chars = sum(len(p.text) for p in packets)
token_estimate = max(total_chars // 4, 1)
initial_density = _count_constraints(policy) / token_estimate
assert initial_density > budget, "Initial density must exceed budget for test"

pruned_packets, _ = _prune_for_coherence(packets, policy, budget)

total_chars_pruned = sum(len(p.text) for p in pruned_packets)
token_estimate_pruned = max(total_chars_pruned // 4, 1)
density_pruned = _count_constraints(policy) / token_estimate_pruned

if density_pruned > budget:
    print("FALSIFIED")
```
